source_review_note: Read independently sourced ProofWiki and Encyclopedia of Mathematics definitions. Strict full-power-set outer-measure convention retains monotonicity; EOM variant and monotonicity omission logged for reconciliation. Original production mathDef content never consulted.

observations.text: An extended nonnegative set function defined on all subsets of X is an outer measure when it vanishes on the empty set, is monotone for inclusion, and is countably subadditive for sequences of subsets.
observations.editorial_note: ProofWiki explicitly states all three conditions including monotonicity; source-restricted mathematical paraphrase, not lifted wording.

observations.text: For an outer measure on all subsets of a metric space, the metric outer-measure property is additivity for any two subsets whose mutual distance is strictly positive.
observations.editorial_note: Encyclopedia of Mathematics article 'Outer measure', Definition 3; cited as a strengthening of standard outer measure, not as independent replacement for its monotonicity condition.

observations.text: A topological space is connected exactly when its underlying set does not split into two disjoint nonempty open sets whose union covers the space.
observations.editorial_note: ProofWiki Definition 1 of connected topological space; the empty space has no nonempty separation and is thus connected under this convention.

observations.text: Connectedness of a topological space is equivalent to having no subset that is both open and closed except the empty set and the whole underlying space.
observations.editorial_note: ProofWiki equivalence article Definition 4 with proof relating no separation to the clopen-set condition; same context, second equivalent formulation.

observations.text: A left action of a group G on a set X is a total assignment G×X to X respecting ordered multiplication of elements of G and the identity action on all x.
observations.editorial_note: ProofWiki left group action definition, including action order (gh)x=g(hx); left orientation is mathematically different from a right action for nonabelian G.

observations.text: A right action of a group G on a set X is a total assignment X×G to X obeying (xg)h=x(gh) and the right identity law xe=x.
observations.editorial_note: ProofWiki right group action definition with explicit order; distinguish from opposite-composition convention and left action.

meanings.context: Measure theory: extended nonnegative outer measure on the full power set of an arbitrary set X

formulations.text: Let X be a set. A function μ*:𝒫(X)→[0,+∞] is an outer measure on X when μ*(∅)=0, A⊆B implies μ*(A)≤μ*(B), and μ*(⋃_{n=1}^∞ Aₙ)≤∑_{n=1}^∞ μ*(Aₙ) for every sequence (Aₙ) of subsets of X.
formulations.mathematical_rationale: Keep empty-set normalization, inclusion monotonicity and countable subadditivity as distinct axioms. The full power-set convention supports arbitrary X including X empty; it is a restricted version of the possible hereditary-sigma-ring domain.

meanings.context: Measure theory on a nonempty metric space (X,d): metric additivity strengthening of a full-power-set outer measure

formulations.text: Let (X,d) be a nonempty metric space and let μ*:𝒫(X)→[0,+∞] be an outer measure. It is a metric outer measure if μ*(A∪B)=μ*(A)+μ*(B) whenever A,B⊆X and inf{d(a,b):a∈A,b∈B}>0, taking inf∅=+∞ when one set is empty.
formulations.mathematical_rationale: The Encyclopedia of Mathematics Definition 3 imposes exact additivity on positively separated subsets. We separately require the standard monotone outer-measure axioms; nonempty X matches the existing independently sourced metric-space meaning and inf-empty convention handles empty A or B.

meanings.context: Point-set topology: connectedness of any topological space, including the empty space

formulations.text: A topological space (X,τ) is connected if there do not exist U,V∈τ with U≠∅, V≠∅, U∩V=∅ and U∪V=X.
formulations.mathematical_rationale: The no-separation characterization is direct from ProofWiki; empty X counts connected because there is no partition into nonempty open subsets, and no Hausdorff or other separation axiom is imposed.

formulations.text: A topological space (X,τ) is connected if every subset C⊆X that is both open and closed in X satisfies C=∅ or C=X.
formulations.mathematical_rationale: ProofWiki states and proves equivalence of the clopen-set characterization and absence of an open separation. The formulation includes the empty ambient space and requires only the open-set topology.

meanings.context: Abstract algebra: left action of a group G on an arbitrary set X

formulations.text: Let (G,·) be a group with identity e and let X be a set. A left action is a map α:G×X→X such that α(e,x)=x and α(g,α(h,x))=α(g·h,x) for all g,h∈G and x∈X.
formulations.mathematical_rationale: Both identity and compatibility are required; order matters in a nonabelian group. Explicit domain G×X distinguishes this left action from a right action, and X may be empty without contradiction.

meanings.context: Abstract algebra: right action of a group G on an arbitrary set X

formulations.text: Let (G,·) be a group with identity e and let X be a set. A right action is a map β:X×G→X such that β(x,e)=x and β(β(x,g),h)=β(x,g·h) for all g,h∈G and x∈X.
formulations.mathematical_rationale: The source-specific ordered composition β(β(x,g),h)=β(x,gh) is required; reversing the group multiplication would change the right-action convention. The domain X×G and identity law distinguish it from a left action; empty X allowed.

relations.editorial_reason: An outer measure has nonnegative extended-real values; defer exact extension-of-reals target rather than substitute ordinary real numbers, which would omit +∞.
relations.target_query: Extended nonnegative real number system [0,+∞] and order

relations.editorial_reason: A metric outer measure is a full-power-set outer measure plus an additional positive-separation additivity condition. Do not mistake this for any measure with domain a σ-algebra.
Positive distance between subsets is defined from the underlying metric d, so the independently reviewed metric-space meaning is a direct structural prerequisite.
The first connectedness condition requires the topology's open-set family and disjoint unions of open subsets; the existing topological-space meaning supports this.
The second characterization uses open and closed subsets relative to the same topological space, with no separation axioms beyond the topology itself.
An action presupposes the group multiplication, identity and associativity; these are source-reviewed by the existing abstract group meaning.
The right-compatibility condition uses group multiplication in the SAME order as the action; the previously reviewed abstract-group prerequisite supplies the identity and multiplication.

issues.reason: Encyclopedia of Mathematics article Outer measure admits hereditary σ-ring domains, in contrast with the full-power-set ProofWiki convention, and its opening definition does not separately state monotonicity. Verify intended convention and whether monotonicity is assumed elsewhere before adding any alternative EOM-based formulation. Do NOT silently merge these axiom/domain variants.
